style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright midday sky
motion_rule: the camera circles the banking biplane without stopping and reverses at 2.5, 5.0 and 7.4, so banknote clouds tear sideways past the frame every half second; the biplane holds its wings flat and sweeps SIDEWAYS across the frame all clip; he throws his whole body into one big action in EVERY beat and travels a full body length in EVERY beat; ONE goose courier flies at the lens in EVERY beat; new shot size every beat; he fills half the frame height; one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a male spotted hyena in a leather flight helmet and goggles, teeth bared
second_characters: ONE goose courier in a mail satchel flying at the lens in every beat
props: the control stick he tears out at 7.4; banknote clouds that shred apart
prop_continuity: the stick stays in the cockpit until 7.4; the biplane stays whole and level to the last frame; the clouds shred, they never become printed sheets; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a bright midday sky packed with small clouds shaped like banknotes

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, even 4.2 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, no silent lead-in; 0.0-1.05 one breath, then engine and wind only; 5.0-6.6 one breath; after 6.6 only sfx
audio.lip_sync: his jaws open on every syllable in every spoken beat, head to the lens, nothing in his mouth while he speaks, never a voice over
audio.sfx: engine droning all clip, wind roar, paper shredding, a wooden crack at 7.4, a paper burst at 8.4

timeline.a: extreme close, head to the lens, he is already hauling on the control stick mid bank, the goose courier flapping at the lens
he wrenches the stick sideways and the biplane sweeps flat across the frame, banknote clouds tearing past
he swings out of the cockpit onto the wing in one throw
he kicks the cockpit door off its hinges and it tumbles away past the camera
he runs the length of the wing and hurls a banknote cloud back past the lens
he vaults onto the upper wing, the goose courier tearing past the lens
he swats two banknote clouds apart with both paws, shreds blasting across the frame
he swings down into the cockpit in one lunge and slams the throttle
he hauls himself upright on the wing, head to the lens, one paw punching the sky
he unbuckles the harness with one paw and flicks it away while the biplane races on level
he plucks the last banknote cloud off the sky and stuffs it inside his flight jacket
he tears the control stick out and throws it straight into the lens, stepping off the wing
he lands flat on a banknote cloud and it bursts into shredded paper under his feet
he sweeps shredded banknotes off his shoulder, head to the lens, while the empty biplane sails away level across the frame behind him, the goose beating at the lens

must_appear: at 0.0 he is already hauling on the stick mid bank and fills the frame, with no entry into shot; at 8.4 he lands on a banknote cloud and it bursts under his feet; at 9.2 he faces the lens on the cloud while the biplane flies away level across the frame
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, letterbox, cyrillic letters, printed digits, a parked camera, a still background, a tailspin, a nose down plane, fire, smoke, a crash, the ground, a horizon line, an empty sky before 6.6, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, a second hyena, speech after 6.6, a human, a parachute
